The PDF tokenizer computes advances from Tz/text state and never deduplicates characters, so the reported letter-drop class has no Varve equivalent. Evidence: packages/import/src/pdf/content.ts, packages/import/src/pdfFidelity.test.ts.
Varve checks PDF output with independent readers. Evidence: scripts/validate-pdf.sh.

Previously painted pixels are always a loan against a fresh frame, with a synchronous worker-admission gate and a hash oracle. Evidence: docs/architecture/render-pipeline.md, tests/e2e/visual/partial-redraw-oracle.spec.ts.
Text is Unicode internally; the native PDF writer outlines non-WinAnsi runs instead of encoding them into a legacy code space. Evidence: crates/varve-print/src/lib.rs.
Varve does not trust the xref table: objects are scanned with bounded budgets and truncation is reported. Evidence: packages/import/src/pdf/objects.ts.
Screen and export share one decoded image cache; the per-replay policy changes requested resolution, not whether content can be read. Evidence: packages/engine/src/replay.ts.
The settings dialog scrolls instead of clipping at 1024x600. Evidence: tests/e2e/ui/chrome-ownership.spec.ts.
The settings dialog scrolls instead of clipping at 1024x600; no native print dialog exists in Varve. Evidence: tests/e2e/ui/chrome-ownership.spec.ts.
A doubled-sign number produces no operand, so the matrix operator is ignored instead of building a degenerate matrix. Evidence: packages/import/src/pdf/content.ts.
A rectangle operator with too few operands is ignored and the stream continues. Evidence: packages/import/src/pdf/content.ts.
Path operators other than axis-aligned rectangles are recorded as non-rectangular; no geometry library call is made that could panic. Evidence: packages/import/src/pdf/content.ts.
Persistent revision history is implemented. Evidence: packages/history/src/index.ts.
Undo is per session by design; durable revisions are kept. Evidence: docs/adr/0019-undo-redo-semantics.md.
The menubar and tab cursors are independent of the tool cursor. Evidence: tests/e2e/ui/chrome-ownership.spec.ts.
Pages carry their own width and height, and a mixed-orientation document round-trips. Evidence: packages/scene/src/documentCodec.test.ts.
